answer: New keys gain grading rights only after locking 90 POA into a personal delta bond that unlocks linearly over 18 epochs of live participation. Each epoch the protocol draws one signal inquiry bound to the key's nonce; unanswered inquiries slash 25 POA toward a nadir floor of 10 POA, which is burned rather than returned. Standing up 500 puppets costs 45,000 POA locked and risks 12,500 burned on the first missed round, whereas one honest agent locks 90 once and answers a single inquiry. Bonds older than 50 epochs unlock without further inquiry.
